niche_preference_profile: Prefers calm, polished interfaces with soft light palettes, generous spacing, clear hierarchy, and restrained surface treatment. They consistently like rounded or gently separated containers, minimal clutter, focused single-purpose flows, and copy that feels supportive rather than technical or alarmist. They often favor understated editorial/product-like presentation over busy utility layouts, though they sometimes also respond positively to stronger hierarchy and more complete, structured content when sparse designs feel unfinished.

criteria.description: More open spacing, generous breathing room, and calmer pacing rather than dense, tightly stacked compositions.
Light, calm, low-contrast presentation with restrained visual intensity rather than dark, harsh, or visually heavy screens.
A strong, readable hierarchy with one clear focal point, simplified top-to-bottom flow, and fewer competing labels or controls.
Cleaner screens with fewer decorative elements, fewer extra modules, and less competing chrome or navigation noise.
Rounded, gently separated, low-contrast cards or surfaces with subtle boundaries instead of rigid, stark, heavily boxed panels.
Conversational, reassuring, approachable wording and emotional framing rather than technical, formal, urgent, or alarm-heavy language.
Selective, disciplined accent color use and polished understated styling rather than loud, neon, overly saturated, or broadly applied accents.
